🚧 MINI EXCAVATION COMPANY

Start with one excavator and build a MINING EMPIRE! 💰

☢️ UPDATE 3.2 • MUTANT OVERLORD
Watch the plaza! When his driller breaks through, you have 10 minutes to shop the Black Market. Trade from Region 1!
🧬 Build 9 mutant machines, from the triple-arm Hydra to the Kraken. Unlock mutant blueprints at Region 10 or after Prestige.
🌎 Dig through 24 regions. Finish Titan’s Heart to Prestige for +50% cash forever!
🎄 Hunt for gifts under the trees! Starting Dec 1, open Rewards → Advent. Your Day 25 gift includes a Kraken and 1,000 diamonds!

🛒 BLACK FRIDAY • 30% OFF game passes until Dec 1!
⚡ 2X CASH for everyone until Sunday at 4 PM PT!
🤫 Use code BLACKFRIDAY in Shop → Codes for cash + 100 diamonds.

⛏️ Mine ores and crystals, upgrade your fleet and hire a crew.
🕳️ Send workers down the Mineshaft for diamonds.
👥 Play with friends for bonus cash and climb the leaderboards!

👍 Like the game for future updates!
🐞 Report bugs in the Roblox Community
